Name: ObjectGroupRuleId
Label: Object Group Rule ID

Name: FormulaCode
Label: Formula Code
Description: The code of the fast formula that dynamically identifies the population to include in the group.

Name: LegislativeDataGroupName
Label: Legislative Data Group Name
Description: The name of the legislative data group.

Name: ObjectGroupCode
Label: Object Group Code
Description: The code of the object group for which rules are being defined.

Name: ObjectGroupLevelName
Label: Object Group Level Name
Description: The name of the level at which the rules are defined, such as Payroll Relationship or Payroll Assignment.

Name: ObjectGroupId

Description: A unique reference to the object group for which rules are being defined.

Name: FormulaId
Label: Formula ID
Description: A unique reference to the fast formula.

Name: LegislativeDataGroupId
Label: Legislative Data Group ID
Description: A unique reference to the legislative data group.

Name: SourceSystemId
Label: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: SourceSystemOwner
Label: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: GUID
Label: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.

Name: SourceRefTableName
Label: Reference Context
